items.headline: Global AI trade could revive after recent pullback, J.P. Morgan says
items.summary: Reuters reported that J.P. Morgan analysts viewed the AI-trade pullback as improving investor positioning and valuation attractiveness, with semiconductor stocks identified as a potential area for renewed engagement.

items.headline: Chinese stocks hit one-year low as tech selloff deepens on Nvidia chip and US sanctions reports
items.summary: Chinese technology shares fell after reports that Beijing may allow local firms to buy Nvidia’s new chips and after proposed US restrictions affecting Chinese optical companies. Reuters reported declines among Cambricon, GigaDevice, Innolight and Eoptolink.

items.headline: Wall Street tug of war: geopolitics and data compete
items.summary: Charles Schwab said investors were weighing inflation and labor data, geopolitics, higher oil prices and Treasury yields, while highlighting upcoming Micron results relevant to AI-memory and semiconductor investors.
